newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-TRAPATTONI MAY GET CONTRACT TO YEAR 2000.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TRAPATTONI MAY GET CONTRACT TO YEAR 2000.

text.p: German league leaders Bayern Munich want to extend the contract of coach Giovanni Trapattoni until the year 2000, manager Uli Hoeness told Friday's edition of the daily Bild.

"As soon as (club president) Franz Beckenbauer and (vice-president) Karl-Heinz Rummenigge arrive, we're going to sit down with Trap and talk about extending his contract for two years," Hoeness told Bild in Bayern's winter training camp in Sardinia.
Trapattoni returned to Bayern Munich at the start of this season after spending a troubled year at the club in 1994-95.
